raisedIn: Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, New York City
background: Born and raised in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, in a Yemeni-American family by a home-health aide mother and a father who works nights at a grocery; she often studies while younger cousins cycle through the kitchen.
regionalHistory: Her parents arrived from Ibb through family reunification; Arabic voice notes from relatives and stories of terrace farms connect her to a place she has visited once.
culturalBaseline: Observant Sunni; she values prayer and modesty but dislikes strangers treating those choices as her complete personality.
